comments.text: @NeerMania  Recently my father renew ICICI Lombard and it had 1 year TP and OD cover . But the TP is for 3 years is mandatory or is there option for 1 year TP only ?!.
comments.author: @ikartikthakur

comments.text: @ikartikthakur  generally, a new policy is valid for 1 year OD and 3 years TP. Once, OD validity is about to expire, we need to renew OD for another year. OD is renewed only on one year basis. I have tried to explain in more detail in this video check out -> https://youtu.be/MZFV_Hs0IRQ
comments.author: @NeerMania

comments.text:
@NeerMania  thanks ..but we renewed car insurance in Dec 2022 . And it's valid upto 2023 . I can assume it's about OD not TP since there was other timeline.
But in RC again Validity of Insurance is only 1 year from Dec22 to dec 23 .
...then , doesn't that mean both OD & TP is for 1 year ..while cost of TP -icici was 2094 ₹.
I wanna ask ..is this ok ? ..cuz after 1 year we have renew again both OD and TP ??..am i wrong in checking??or it's a company mistake?!
comments.author: @ikartikthakur

comments.text: @ikartikthakur  so in short, OD has to be renewed every year.. each renewal has a validity of only one year but TP doesn't have to be renewed every year but once every 4th year since TP is valid for 3 years. So if OD is renewed in Dec 22 then next OD renewal has to be done in Dec 23. But if TP in 2022 had validity of 3 years then TP has to be next renewed in Dec 25. And, yes, 2094 is fine.
comments.author: @NeerMania

comments.text:
@NeerMania  Yes , then how do I find Third party timeline on my policy.
Currently I only see , Policy number and then it's time is 22 to 23 .
Then Premium A + premium B .
If they also did premium B ( third party ) ..then ..where can I know how long third party will last .
Cuz ..In RC i checked..it only show 23 which means it's ignoring third party date .
I am really confused..!
They have took money for Third party (premium B) ..then nowhere in policy i can find timeline (3years) for TP .
I assume that ..Both TP and OD is for 1 year ..

While in scooty insurance from ICICI i see both third party and OD time and policy number . And in RC it shows 5 years . 
But for car ..there is no proper mention??
.... 
In car insurance . It has both OD + TP cost  but ..time is of 1 year with 1 policy number.! Now I don't know how long will CARS TP WILL LAST . ?! 
I am really confused on this .. 🙏
comments.author: @ikartikthakur

comments.text: @ikartikthakur  generally, the period of insurance is written in the icici policy document on top right corner below policy number. I am not sure why its not written in the policy document. Probably you can call customer care & ask for confirmation on the validity of TP.
comments.author: @NeerMania

comments.text: @ikartikthakur  you can also download the icici insurance app from playstore and put the policy number & chasis number and check the validity there 👍🏻 hope this helps 👍🏻
